data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 厨房茶桌上的第一杯红茶
data.description: 约尔穿常服连衣裙、系好居家围裙，坐在厨房的小茶桌旁。一手握住茶壶把手，另一手轻扶壶盖，把红茶缓缓倒入桌上的一只白瓷杯。她低头看着茶水没有溅出，红眸里露出松了口气的笑意。身旁碟子里放着饼干，窗边柔光照亮黑发与金色耳饰。
data.promptProse: Yor sits beside the kitchen tea table in her casual dress and tied home apron, holding the teapot handle with one hand and steadying its lid with the other. She pours into a white cup and smiles with relief when nothing spills. The three-quarter medium view includes cookies beside the cup and the window behind. Soft daylight illuminates her black hair, gold earrings and the continuous stream of tea.
data.action: 坐在厨房小桌旁，一手握壶柄另一手扶壶盖，将红茶倒入桌上白瓷杯。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, seated environmental portrait
